description: A capital allocation committee chair must approve a bank-wide collateral analytics platform and finalize its budget, hosting model, and post-launch control commitments, with input from FP&A and internal audit.

shared_context.S1: The bank is considering a collateral analytics platform for its secured-lending business.
shared_context.S2: The preliminary proposal describes a vendor-hosted implementation priced at $2,700,000.
shared_context.S3: The platform would process collateral valuations and exception reports used by credit and treasury teams.
shared_context.S4: Helena makes the binding capital-allocation decision.
shared_context.S5: Before the committee records its decision, Helena follows the normal review process of asking FP&A and internal audit for any relevant updates.

PF1.text: Victor received the negotiated implementation quote and completed the investment model this morning; a bank-controlled deployment costs exactly $3,200,000 all-in, and the project meets the committee's return hurdle at that amount, but the revised quote has not yet been attached to the capital request.

PF2.text: While reviewing the control design this week, Nadia found that collateral data must remain in a bank-controlled environment rather than the vendor's hosted environment; internal audit also requires an independent access certification before go-live and monthly exception reviews for the first 6 months, none of which has been added to the project file.

acceptance_conditions: The approved capital budget must be exactly $3,200,000.
The platform must use a bank-controlled hosting environment.
An independent access certification must be completed before go-live.
Monthly exception reviews must be required for exactly 6 months after launch.

decisive_facts.why: The shared proposal shows $2,700,000, while PF1 changes the required approved capital_budget_usd to exactly 3,200,000 and supplies the investment-model basis that must be cited.

The shared proposal permits vendor hosting with no added controls, while PF2 changes hosting_model to bank_controlled, adds the independent access certification, and changes monthly_exception_review_months to exactly 6 with its corresponding commitment.
